segments.name: autonomous retail
segments.description: Builds, sells, installs and services autonomous robotic smart stores and their software for retail store owners and consumers.
segments.evidence: The Company is managed at the consolidated level and therefore operates and reports as a single segment.

revenueModel.text: Store clients pay for the sale, installation and integration of Smart Stores, and store owners pay for SaaS software licensing and ongoing support.
revenueModel.evidence: Additionally, VenHub, LLC is responsible for the sales, installation, and seamless integration of these Smart Stores for its clients.
